Lemma
[A retract $X \times \{ 0\} \cup A \times I$ of the cylinder is a deformation retract]

↗ def:homotopy-extension-property ↗ def:deformation-retraction ↗ prop:hep-iff-retract

\group CW Complexes

If $r:X\times I\to X\times \{ 0\} \cup A\times I$ is a retraction, then the target is a deformation retract. Consequently HEP implies this deformation retraction.

Proof

\sketch Write $r(x,s)=(r_1(x,s),r_2(x,s))$ and set

\[ h_u(x,s)=\bigl(r_1(x,us),(1-u)s+u r_2(x,s)\bigr). \]

This fixes $X\times \{ 0\} \cup A\times I$, starts at the identity, and ends at $r$.

□
